arcmenu_editor.property.type_hint: region creates a normal click region. Arcitx creates a text editing region that must bind a frontend text node and a separate submit region.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_text_hint: Frontend text node ID that displays this Arcitx buffer. Each input must bind its own text node.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_submit_hi: A separate normal backend click region that confirms this buffer. Editing and submitting must use different, nonoverlapping regions. Closing the anvil only keeps a draft.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_title_hin: Title of the native anvil input window. Touch mode uses the normal anvil; mouse mode hides its appearance.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_initial_h: Initial buffer value. Reopening the input restores its current draft instead of resetting to this value.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_max_lengt: Maximum 1 to 50 UTF-16 units, matching the native anvil. Chinese text and spaces are accepted; spaces do not submit.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_mask_hint: Empty displays the input text. One Unicode character masks the displayed buffer without changing the actual input value.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_display_b: Text displayed before editing. Use this state for an input prompt; formatting codes are supported.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_display_e: Text displayed while the anvil is editing. {input} displays the buffer and {caret} displays the blinking caret. Chinese input-method composition stays in the native input field until committed.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_display_d: Text displayed after leaving the anvil, before submission. {input} displays the retained draft. Click the editing region again to revise it.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_display_c: Text displayed after clicking the submit region. {input} displays the confirmed value. The editing region remains available for changes.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_caret_con: Text inserted for {caret} during the visible blink phase while editing, usually an underscore.
arcmenu_editor.property.arcitx_caret_int: Positive tick interval between caret blink phases. The caret stops blinking after leaving the anvil.
arcmenu_editor.property.on_hover_hint: Runs once when the pointer enters this click region. Use YAML reaction lists or maps with priority, condition, deny and actions; animation: track-id plays a menu animation. [] clears the event. Use \n for line breaks.
arcmenu_editor.property.on_leave_hint: Runs once when the pointer leaves this click region. Uses the same YAML reactions as On hover; animation: track-id can restore the normal appearance. [] clears the event. Use \n for line breaks.
